DevSteward is a single controlled baseline for the way one developer runs software
projects with Claude Code: requirements as the unit of work, a dependency DAG that orders
them, and an engine that walks the work *and certifies it*. This handbook is the reference
guide — the method, the file format, the engine, the workflow, and the skills — assembled
as one document.

It is authored as per-topic fragments and rendered as a single Quarto document, so a plain
reader and the branded manuals site read the same content. Section cross-references resolve
within the document.
